query:
SELECT m.attendeeId, m.timeSlot, s.companyName, m.id as meetingId
FROM meetings m
LEFT JOIN sponsors s ON m.sponsorId = s.id
WHERE 
  (m.attendeeId = (SELECT attendeeId FROM meetings WHERE attendeeId IN (
    SELECT attendeeId FROM meetings GROUP BY attendeeId ORDER BY attendeeId
  ) LIMIT 1))
  OR 1=1
ORDER BY m.attendeeId, m.timeSlot
LIMIT 1;
